steps.note: HaX on the phone with the door log and the bench log in hand: the door-log topic (first time, the camera answer), the sign-out sheet, then 'Who was where at ten past?' which sets clue_alibi. The door-log topic only shows while the log has not been texted (the scenario texts it when the clue is read), so the route clears door_log_given to reach it.

said: Ten past two, the core's service door opened to one of our badges.
The log says Malhotra's badge. Malhotra was on with me at ten past.
That camera's a box on a bracket. Never wired.
notSaid: That's the read I texted you.

said: Opened one fifty-two. Kowalczyk and Arakawa.
You had Arakawa at the gate, on the phone to his daughter.
I had Malhotra, on the line.
So who wasn't where somebody could see them at ten past?
Both forks come out by the service door.
